projection_version.description: Version of this MCP projection of the decision. Currently bestprice_mcp_decision_v1; a later bestprice_mcp_decision_v<N> is returned without a tools/list change.

decision_version.description: Shopping Brain decision contract version. Currently bestprice_decision_v1; a later bestprice_decision_v<N> is returned without a tools/list change.

evidence_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the original, unmodified Brain evidence; the public evidence below is a returned-product subset.

methodology_id.description: Basket planning method. Currently bestprice_basket_bounded_v1; a revised method is returned as a new <name>_v<N> id without a tools/list change.

version.description: Basket request version. Currently bestprice_basket_request_v1; a later bestprice_basket_request_v<N> is returned without a tools/list change.

type.description: Advisory step for the shopper, never an action for the agent. compare: review current offers at bestprice_url. create_alert: the current price is above its typical 180-day price; the shopper may set a price alert on the BestPrice page at bestprice_url (no tool creates alerts). provide_context: the request needs a change or more detail from the shopper.

version.description: Ranking policy version. Currently bestprice_shopping_policy_v1; a later bestprice_shopping_policy_v<N> is returned without a tools/list change.

product.description: Product ranking rule. Known values: hard_constraints_then_fit_and_marginal_value. New values are added without a tools/list change.

merchant.description: Merchant ranking rule. Known values: lowest_known_comparable_cost, basket_objective. New values are added without a tools/list change.

version.description: Retrieval receipt version. Currently bestprice_retrieval_v1; a later bestprice_retrieval_v<N> is returned without a tools/list change.

policy.description: Catalog retrieval policy. Currently single_catalog_page_v1; a revised method is returned as a new <name>_v<N> id without a tools/list change.

backend.description: Catalog search backend that served the page. Known values: n.products.search, bp.search. New values are added without a tools/list change.

search_calls.description: Catalog searches the retrieval policy made; currently always 1.

version.description: Shopping-context projection version. Currently bestprice_shopping_context_v29; a later bestprice_shopping_context_v<N> is returned without a tools/list change.

catalog_candidates.description: Present only on a no_match that returns no product: one bounded BestPrice catalog search page for the request, with signed product links. Search results, not a recommendation; the Shopping Brain did not rank or verify them against the request.

__schema0.description: Result schema version. Currently 2.0; a later <major>.<minor> is returned without a tools/list change.

merchant_logo_url.description: BestPrice CDN logo of the store; null when the store has none.

shipping_unknown_cause.description: Why shipping is unknown: missing when the store published no usable shipping cost, invalid when it published one this service refuses to trust. Null whenever shipping_status is known or estimated.

condition.description: Item condition; treat an unrecognized value as unknown. Known values: new, refurbished, used, open_box, unknown. New values are added without a tools/list change.

__schema16.description: True when this is a BestPrice-certified store (Πιστοποιημένο κατάστημα).

__schema17.description: BestPrice certification tier of the store (php/classes/Merchant.php verification_level 1..4); null when not certified.

__schema19.description: Current item price in EUR before shipping.

__schema21.description: Known or estimated shipping price in EUR; null means unknown.

__schema25.description: Delivered total in EUR; null whenever shipping is unknown.

__schema26.description: Offer availability; treat an unrecognized value as unknown. Known values: in_stock, delivery_1_3_days, delivery_4_7_days, delivery_4_10_days, delivery_8_14_days, by_order, to_order, preorder, out_of_stock, unknown. New values are added without a tools/list change.

__schema32.description: Catalog lowest listed item price in EUR before shipping. Same identity as compare_offers.catalog_price_from. Not a buyable quote; it may be a promoted, out-of-stock, or filtered offer that compare_offers omits. Never subtract this from another product compare_offers item_price.

__schema33.description: Signed, anonymous id joining this recommendation to its BestPrice landing and outbound-click telemetry.

verified_merchant.description: True when this is a BestPrice-certified store (Πιστοποιημένο κατάστημα).

certification_level.description: BestPrice certification tier of the store (php/classes/Merchant.php verification_level 1..4); null when not certified.

family.description: Catalog attribute family of the product. Known values: laptops, phones, televisions, air_conditioners, air_fryers, espresso_machines, headphones, monitors, mice, refrigerators, vacuums, washing_machines, dishwashers, chairs, tablets, power_banks, smartwatches, printers, routers, desktops, freezers, microwaves, kettles, fans, bicycles, unknown. New values are added without a tools/list change.

not_collected.description: Offer facts BestPrice does not collect: currently returns_policy, warranty, payment_fees, pickup, merchant_feed_updated_at, guaranteed_postcode_delivery. The list changes as facts are collected, without a tools/list change.

compatibility.description: Product compatibility assessment. Known values: not_assessed. New values are added without a tools/list change.

rating.description: BestPrice shopper rating for this product: average of count first-party ratings. Null when the product has none.

kind.description: Evidence source kind. Known values: catalog_snapshot, merchant_offer, basket_quote, price_history, review_sample, decision_policy. New values are added without a tools/list change.
